description: Browse the Liliphant API API docs, one level at a time. Call it without arguments to get the top level: the modules and pages with a short description and the endpoints they hold. Call it with `path` set to a module's or page's link (or path) to get what is inside it; each listing links the next level. Call it with `path` set to an endpoint's link ending in ".openapi.yml" to get that endpoint as an OpenAPI file: method, url, headers, query params, path variables, a request body example and sample responses. Fetch only the level you need.

path.description: A link from a listing, exactly as given (e.g. "https://docs.example.com/sms/llms.txt" or ".../sms/send-sms.openapi.yml"), or just the path ("sms", "sms/send-sms.openapi.yml"). Leave it out for the top level.

name: get_liliphant_api_docs
